reason: A DSH status-bar plugin that monitors local CPU, memory, disk, load, and uptime, with periodic refresh and on-demand updates.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 底部状态栏实时显示本机 CPU、内存、磁盘、负载和运行时间信息。
summaries.en: Displays real-time local CPU, memory, disk, load, and uptime metrics in the DeepSeek Harness bottom status bar.

capabilities: Reads local CPU, memory, disk, load, and uptime metrics using Node os and fs modules
Serves sampled metrics through a local /dsh-sysmon route
Displays and periodically refreshes resource metrics in the DSH status bar
